description: Get the full text of one policy section by id, with its title, version and the dispute categories it applies to.

section_id.description: Section id as returned by search_policy, for example time-limits.

name: get_policy_section
title: Get policy section

description: Search the card dispute policy for the sections relevant to a question, best match first. Combines keyword and semantic search. Each hit has a section id, title, the matching passage and the categories it applies to. Cite section ids in decisions.

category.description: Only return sections that apply to this dispute category. Omit to search all sections.

max_results.description: How many sections to return, 1 to 10. Omit for 5.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "time limit for opening a dispute".

name: search_policy
title: Search policy
